variants.name: A «Низкий кузов»
variants.description: Низкий открытый кузов и короткий корпус; рука на передней поперечине.
variants.shape: Low compact rectangular chassis with two continuous track belts, rear open shallow cargo bed occupying rear two thirds, one articulated arm pedestal mounted at the very FRONT CENTER crossmember. Arm shoulder in front of cargo bed, upper arm can fold back over bed; shown neutral with elbow up just enough and claw pointing down ahead of nose. Low side equipment boxes.
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE realistic hard-surface RTS game HUMAN unmanned WORKER DRONE concept. Reference 1 shows previous wheel worker only for faction identity; CHANGE TO TRACKS and relocate arm as specified. Reference 2 is faction building only for sand beige matte panels, graphite recesses, muted orange fixed accents, realistic steel, lightly worn surfaces. CRITICAL: exactly TWO continuous CATERPILLAR TRACK BELTS, left and right, no exposed road tires, no wheels outside tracks, no legs, no cabin, no driver, no weapons. One SINGLE articulated industrial utility arm mounted at FRONT CENTER of vehicle, on its longitudinal centerline at the nose, NOT on rear or side. OPEN cargo bed at REAR BEHIND arm, visually unobstructed reach from front arm over chassis to rear bed. Arm must plausibly reach ground in front AND rear bed using shoulder rotation/folding and elbow, not an enormous crane. Small dark unlit optical sensors integrated in front corners, no tall central sensor to obstruct arm. Design supports facing ore deposit to mine, transferring a small ore chunk back into bed, reversing to HQ and unloading backwards via rear transfer interface/gate. Do not illustrate the sequence or ore here: empty bed and neutral parked machine only. All lights/optics OFF, NO glow, sparks, beam, smoke, people, text, borders, inset panels or arrows. Elevated front-left 3/4 studio view, entire machine with generous margin on warm gray plain background, soft shadows, strict practical proportions and reasonably slim panels, not cartoon. Sand upper track covers and side bed panels reserved for separate future owner-color mask, shown sand now. Variant: Low compact rectangular chassis with two continuous track belts, rear open shallow cargo bed occupying rear two thirds, one articulated arm pedestal mounted at the very FRONT CENTER crossmember. Arm shoulder in front of cargo bed, upper arm can fold back over bed; shown neutral with elbow up just enough and claw pointing down ahead of nose. Low side equipment boxes.

variants.shape: Sloped sand wedge nose above two continuous track belts, FRONT CENTER articulated industrial arm base mounted on nose, open rear cargo tray with low sidewalls behind arm, one slim shoulder-elbow-wrist manipulator with sufficient long links to reach back into rear tray. Neutral stowed claw in front of nose, not above rear bed. Strong wedge front silhouette and graphite undercut sides.
